evidence.detail: SUM(num_decks) AS num_decks with no IFNULL; LEFT JOIN means archetypes with no rows in _arch_stats produce NULL, rendered as 'None' in the template
{{num_decks}} rendered directly with no null guard

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/archetype.py change line 549 from `SUM(num_decks) AS num_decks` to `IFNULL(SUM(num_decks), 0) AS num_decks` in load_archetypes. Also apply the same fix at line 610 inside load_disjoint_archetypes. Optionally add a HAVING clause to exclude zero-deck archetypes from display — but bakert's own comment flags that as a product call, so the IFNULL fix alone closes the reported bug.
triage.notes: Reporter's comment notes the archetype was 'emptied' of decks but not deleted; the IFNULL fix shows 0 instead of None. Whether to filter 0-deck archetypes entirely is a separate product decision.
